name: Replays
author: byo-pop
description: Records every game played from its start to its end (the newest 50, and every one that made a high-score table). Watch one with R on the game-over page, -replay=<file>, or the web page's Replays panel: 1 to 4 set the speed, space pauses, Esc stops. Play is unchanged, so games keep the usual high scores.
